bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
root="$(pwd -P)"
service=gace-userbot-verify.service
printf 'USERBOT_WORKDIR_MATCH=%s\n' "$(test "$(systemctl --user show -p WorkingDirectory --value "$service")" = "$root" && echo yes || echo no)"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$service"
python3 -B scripts/userbot_test_client.py health
for f in userbot_resident_ipc.py userbot_test_client.py; do
 printf 'LIVE_BLOB %s %s\n' "$f" "$(git hash-object "scripts/$f")"
 git log -1 --format='SOURCE_COMMIT %H' -- "scripts/$f"
 git status --porcelain -- "scripts/$f"
done
printf 'ROOT_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'BURST_STAGE_EXISTS=%s\n' "$(test -d deploy/state/reliability-pr81-e2368044/userbot && echo yes || echo no)"
printf 'BOT_IMAGE_MATCH=%s\n' "$(test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:reliability-e2368044)" && echo yes || echo no)"
cd /home/gace/server-core
python3 -B scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py req_20261128044000000000b848 --writer-ledger --writer-dir "$HOME/.local/state/gserver-terminal/results"
python3 -B scripts/servercore_host_output_private_artifact_publish.py req_20261128044200000000b849 --writer-ledger --writer-dir "$HOME/.local/state/gserver-terminal/results"
